scope: P35 full reset experiment probability certificate with positive M and N
P48 conditional sequential confidence accounting and robust accepted/stopped stages
development_diagnostics: Initial NNReal notation was misparsed; replaced with explicit NNReal.
Measurability set and absolute-value tactics required pinned-API adjustments.
An omitted explicit continuous-linear-map argument in opNorm_le_bound caused elaboration timeout; giving the map fixed it.
Unused-variable and sequencing lints were corrected.
limitations: P35 does not prove reset independence or coverage from raw measured data. They remain declared protocol hypotheses.
P48 assumes actual conditional coverage and exact soundness over all members of each uncertainty set. It does not validate either premise from selection alone.
The mathematical statement requires a positive trial count and a nonempty selected experiment set for the logarithmic radius.
